label: def:yekutieli-triple
title: Lifting triple mapping
html:
Let (\mathbf{C}, A, \tau) be a quantum observable universe with recursive brane tower \{A_n\}_{n \geq 0} (recursive brane tower) and substrate parameter q. Let \{U_i\} be a covering of the underlying site \mathcal{S} trivialising every level of the tower. The Yekutieli lifting triple at level n over an intersection U_i \cap U_j is the datum (x_{ij}^{(n)}, g_{ij}^{(n)}, a_{ij}^{(n)}), where:

  1. Objects. x_i^{(n)} \in \mathrm{Ob}(\mathfrak{G}_n|_{U_i}) are local trivialisations of the Frobenius--Hopf object A_n.
  2. 1-morphisms. g_{ij}^{(n)} \colon x_i^{(n)} \to x_j^{(n)} are the transition automorphisms in \mathrm{Aut}_{\mathbf{C}}(A_n|_{U_i \cap U_j}). They encode the patching data of the comultiplication \Delta_n.
  3. 2-morphisms. a_{ij}^{(n)} \colon g_{ij}^{(n)} \Rightarrow g_{ij}^{(n+1)} are the deformation parameters living in the band \mathcal{B}. They implement the lift of transition automorphisms from level n to level n{+}1.

The assignment n \mapsto (x^{(n)}, g^{(n)}, a^{(n)}) is functorial. The jet prolongation (jet prolongation) sends the triple at level n to the triple at level n{+}1. The descent homomorphism \mathfrak{d}_{n+1} (descent) reverses this assignment. In the archimedean realisation, g_{ij}^{(n)} \in \Gamma(U_i \cap U_j, \mathrm{SU}_{q_n}(2)) are gauge transition functions and a_{ij}^{(n)} \in \mathcal{O}_M^{\times}.
